pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.2: tena kho pana samayena rājā Pasenadi Kosalo senāya abbhuyyāto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.4: addasa kho rājā Pasenadi Kosalo chabbaggiye bhikkhū dūrato 'va āgacchante,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya āgacchissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.12: amhākaṃ pi alābhā amhākaṃ pi dulladdhaṃ ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu puttadārassa kāraṇā senāya āgacchāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.13: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gacchissantīti. bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.16: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gacchathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.19: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gacchissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.20: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.21: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.22.1: yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.23: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno mātulo senāya gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.2: so tassa bhikkhuno santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.6: atha kho tassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi: bhagavatā sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ na uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gantabban ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.7: ayañ ca me mātulo senāya gilāno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.8: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.10: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.12: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.13.1: yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpapaccayā, pācittiyan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.1.6: gāmato nikkhamitvā niviṭṭhā vā hoti payātā vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.1.9: dvādasapuriso hatthī, tipuriso asso, catupuriso ratho, cattāro purisā sarahatthā patti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.1.12: dassanūpacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.2.1: uyyutte uyyuttasaññī dassanāya gacchati aññatra tathārūpapaccayā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.2.6: dassanūpacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.3.3: bhikkhussa ṭhitokāsaṃ vā nisinnokāsaṃ vā nipannokāsaṃ vā āgacchati,
